about: Plain-language explanations of common errors, for run logs and Explain this error. An entry matches when any of its patterns matches (or the run ended with one of its exitCodes) and every pattern in with matches too. Patterns are regular expressions, applied line by line (multiline) and case-sensitive unless ignoreCase is true. {{1}} in a text is group 1 of the pattern that matched; {{file}} and {{line}} come from the first location pattern that matches (group 1 the file, group 2 the line), and explanationAt replaces explanation when there is one. A fix names an action the app or the editor carries out.

errors.title: That port is already taken
errors.explanation: Another program already uses this port, so this one cannot start on it. Stop the other task, or change the port in the run profile.

errors.title: Not inside a project folder
errors.explanation: There is no package.json here, so this is not a project folder. Open the project, then try again.

errors.title: Node.js is not installed
errors.explanation: That language is not installed, or the terminal cannot find it. Setting up the Node.js recipe checks that it works.

errors.title: Python is not installed
errors.explanation: That language is not installed, or the terminal cannot find it. Setting up the Python recipe checks that it works.

patterns: Failed to establish a new connection
errors.title: No internet connection
errors.explanation: The package registry could not be reached, so there is probably no internet connection. Connect to the internet, or start from a template that is ready offline.

errors.title: Android blocked a downloaded program
errors.explanation: A package tried to start a program it downloaded, and Android does not let apps run programs downloaded that way. Use a tool that works without one, such as Vite 8.

errors.title: A Python package is missing
errors.explanation: The Python package {{1}} is not installed in this project. Install it in the project's environment: .venv/bin/python -m pip install {{1}}

errors.title: A typing mistake in the code
errors.explanation: The code has a typing mistake, such as a missing bracket, quote or comma, so it cannot run.
errors.explanationAt: The code has a typing mistake, such as a missing bracket, quote or comma, in {{file}} at line {{line}}.

fixes.label: Open the file at that line

errors.title: Android stopped the program
errors.explanation: Android stopped the program, most often because the phone ran low on memory. Close other apps and try again. Health shows what uses memory.

errors.title: The phone is out of storage
errors.explanation: There is no free space left, so files could not be written. Free up some space, then try again.

errors.title: Not enough memory
errors.explanation: The program needed more memory than the phone could give it. Turn on low-memory mode, or run this project on your laptop.

errors.title: Turbopack does not run on Android
errors.explanation: Newer Next.js builds with Turbopack by default, and Turbopack does not run on Android. Run the dev server with webpack instead: npm run dev -- --webpack

patterns: Please tell me who you are
errors.title: Git needs your name and email
errors.explanation: Git records who made each change, and it does not know your name and email yet. Set them once, and commits work.
